name: Third-body gravity and rotating-frame kernels
purpose: Verify Sun/Earth differential gravity, centrifugal acceleration, Coriolis acceleration, and frame-update consistency.
production_capability: Orbit-enabled branches of Moon::TotalParticleAcceleration and amps_time_step.
configuration: _EXOSPHERE__ORBIT_CALCUALTION__MODE_=ON; J2000 inertial, LSO rotating, MOON_ME_DE421 body-fixed; geometric aberration NONE; DE421 kernel set.
independent_reference: Direct differential-gravity and -Omega cross (Omega cross r)-2 Omega cross v equations; angular velocity independently recovered from W=(dR/dt)R^T using the derivative block of the SPICE state transform.
units: m, s, m s^-2, rad s^-1
frame_time_convention: J2000 inertial; Moon-centred LSO rotating; MOON_ME_DE421 body-fixed; UTC converted by naif0012.tls to SPICE ET/TDB; aberration correction NONE for forces.
procedure: Compare isolated terms and a one-step frame update against independent vector algebra and SPICE transforms.
acceptance_criteria: Each force and angular-velocity component is within 1e-12 relative (with declared 1e-18 m s^-2 and 1e-20 rad s^-1 absolute floors); rotation orthogonality error <=1e-13; exact configured frame-name checks pass.
expected_pass_result: Each inertial/non-inertial term and frame update agrees independently.
status_semantics: PASS requires evaluation of every linked production kernel and exact hashes for all declared kernels; a missing kernel is SKIPPED and a build/runtime/parser failure is ERROR.
